users.description: One row per signed-in user. MVP only ever has the single hardcoded 'user' row (see root AGENTS.md), and Part 4's login route checks the hardcoded credentials in code rather than this table — `password` is stored here (plaintext, matching the hardcoded value) so the table is a complete, ready-to-use source of truth once real multi-user auth replaces the hardcoded check; it should hold a proper password hash at that point, not plaintext.

boards.description: One row per board. `user_id` is a plain (non-unique) FK: the MVP's 'one board per user' rule is enforced by application logic (get-or-create the user's board), not by the schema, so multi-board later needs no migration.

columns.description: The board's columns. Per root AGENTS.md the set of columns is fixed (only the title can be edited) — `position` is assigned once when the board is created and never changes.

cards.description: Cards belonging to a column. `position` determines render order within `column_id` and is what the backend rewrites when a card is added, deleted, or moved (within or across columns).

example._comment: Mirrors frontend/src/lib/kanban.ts's initialData exactly, showing the schema loses nothing from the current demo board. This is also the data Part 6 will use to seed a fresh database.
